title: Peter Garyaev's retracted Nobel nomination and death

tellings.quote: gentleman Peter Garyaev who was nominated for the Nobel Prize in 2019 or 2020. The nomination was retracted and he later died, I believe, under mysterious circumstances.

plain: A podcast guest, Dave Rossi, told the host Jesse Michels about a Russian scientist named Peter Garyaev, known from a website on what it calls linguistic wave genetics, an idea that genes respond to something like language. Rossi says Garyaev was nominated for the Nobel Prize, science's top award, in 2019 or 2020, that the nomination was taken back, and that he later died, Rossi believes, in mysterious circumstances. He tells it as a sign that such ideas may be pushed aside.
